title: Swept Away
start: Talk to Maggie the witch at her caravan, north of Draynor Village, west of the Draynor lodestone.

recommended.t: Active lodestones in Draynor Village and Port Sarim.

rewards.t: 10 portions of experience-giving goulash, and a bowl to collect it with (each drink gives experience equal to ten times the corresponding skill level, or five times if used for Invention)

steps.t: Talk to Maggie who is located just west of the Draynor lodestone. [Chat: 1 Oo, something smells rather...interesting! › 1 Is there any way I could help? › Accept › 1 Sure, I can do that for you.]
Talk to Betty in furthest north-western house in Port Sarim. [Chat: 1 Talk to Betty about Swept Away.]
Enter the trapdoor in the south-east corner of the house.
Talk to Lottie. [Chat: 2 I need to retrieve Betty's wand.]
p: The three crates in Hetty's basement

steps.t: Complete the puzzle.

sub.t: Put the blackbird in the holding pen.
Put the rat in the blackbird pen.
Put the spider in the spiders pen.
Put the lizard in the reptiles pen.
Put the rat in the rat pen.
Put the blackbird in the blackbird pen.

steps.t: Open and search the chest near the ladder you came from.
Climb up the ladder and talk to Betty. [Chat: 1 Talk to Betty about Swept Away.]
Head to Rimmington (run southwest from Betty's shop in Port Sarim).
Talk to Hetty. [Chat: 2 Talk about Swept Away.]
Enter the trapdoor just south of her house.
Talk to Gus. [Chat: 1 It's a deal.]
Take from the crate that's labelled "Newts and Toads".
Place the label of the creature you removed on that box.
If you placed the "Newts" label previously, place the "Toads" label on the "Newts" crate. Otherwise place the "Newts" label on the "Toads" crate.
Place the remaining label on the last box and talk to Gus.
Take a newt from the newt crate.
Talk to Hetty. [Chat: 2 Talk about Swept Away.]
Use the ointment on the broom.
Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village. [Chat: 2 Talk about Swept Away. › 1 Yes, I'm ready to go now.] You will get teleported to a new area.
Talk to Aggie again.
Complete the puzzle.
Talk to Aggie [Chat: 3 I'd like to go back to Draynor, please.]
p: One possible solution for Aggie's puzzle

steps.t: Talk to Maggie. [Chat: 1 I have good news for you. › 1 Of course I could.]
Stir the cauldron with the broomstick.
p: Using the broom to stir the goulash

steps.t: Talk to Maggie. [Chat: 1 I've stirred the cauldron for you.]
Quest complete!

sub.t: If drinking the Goulash after the quest, you may want to disable the setting that destroys empty bowls when eating.

get_inside.text: Teleport using an amulet of glory to the Draynor Market.
Home Teleport to Draynor lodestone just north of the village (near the portal to Death's office).
Use War's Retreat Teleport and immediately exit via the ground portal to the north of the village.
Use an explorer's ring 3 to teleport to the Falador cabbage patch and then run south then east through the stone wall and then south will teleport to the Draynor Market.
The master archaeologist's outfit hat's teleport function (collectors menu) to the Wise Old Man.
